name: Event
definition: A student club activity such as a meeting, speaker, game, social, election, registration, community service activity or budget review. Each event carries a name, a date, a type, an optional location, free-text notes and a lifecycle status.
scope: Identifies the club activity that attendance, budget lines and (indirectly) expenses belong to.

name: Member
definition: A person registered with the student club, holding a first name, last name, email, club position, t-shirt size, phone number, home zip code and a reference to an academic major.
scope: The person dimension for attendance, expenses attributed to a member, income paid by a member, and club office holding.

name: Major
definition: An academic degree program offered by the university, described by a program name, the hosting department, and the college it sits in.
scope: Academic background of a member; the anchor for major name, department and college analysis.

name: Budget Line
definition: A budget allocation for one spending category of one event, recording the amount allotted, the amount spent against it, the amount remaining and a snapshot of the event status.
scope: Event-level financial planning and budget-versus-actual comparison.

name: Expense
definition: A single spending record: what was bought, on which date, at what cost, whether it was approved, which member incurred it and which budget line it is charged to.
scope: Itemized spending analysis, including per-member spending and per-event cost.

name: Income
definition: Money received by the club on a given date from a source such as dues, fundraising, sponsorship or a school appropriation, optionally attributed to a member.
scope: Club revenue analysis by source and by paying member.

name: Attendance Record
definition: A link between one member and one event, recording that the member attended that event. The pair (event, member) is unique.
scope: Event participation and head-count analysis; the only source of event attendance.

name: Zip Code Reference
definition: A postal geography lookup that maps a zip code to an area type, city, county, state and short state.
scope: Geographic enrichment of a member's home location and standalone geography questions.

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle state of an event as recorded on the event itself: Closed, Open or Planning.
scope: Filtering and reporting on event lifecycle state, including questions about closed or open events.

name: Budget Line Event Status
definition: A copy of the linked event's lifecycle status stored on each budget line, so budget analysis can be filtered by event status without joining the event table.
scope: Used when budget data is analysed on its own; the value always coincides with the linked event's status.

name: Event Type
definition: The category of a club event: Meeting, Election, Game, Guest Speaker, Social, Registration, Community Service or Budget.
scope: Classifying events when a question refers to a kind of activity.

name: Event Name
definition: The human-readable label of an event, used to identify an event in questions and as the join point for budget and expense analysis at event level.
scope: Resolving a named meeting or activity mentioned in a question to its event record.

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending category a budget line is allocated to: Food, Advertisement, Speaker Gifts, Parking or Club T-Shirts.
scope: Budget breakdowns by purpose of spending.

name: Expense Description
definition: Free-text description of what an expense purchased, such as Pizza, Posters, Parking or Water, Cookies. Values are literal strings rather than a controlled vocabulary.
scope: Identifying the kind or type of an expense.

name: Expense Date
definition: The calendar date on which an expense was incurred, recorded as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). The month of an expense is read from this value.
scope: Time-based spending analysis such as month or period filtering.

name: Member Position
definition: The club standing or office held by a member: President, Vice President, Treasurer, Secretary, Member, or Inactive.
scope: Distinguishing officers, ordinary members and inactive members.

name: Club Officer
definition: A member holding an elected club office: President, Vice President, Treasurer or Secretary. This is a subset of the member position domain, distinct from the ordinary Member and Inactive standings.
scope: Questions about club leadership rather than the general membership.

name: T-Shirt Size
definition: The apparel size recorded for a member: Small, Medium, Large or X-Large.
scope: Member apparel and merchandise sizing analysis.

name: Member Phone Number
definition: The contact telephone number stored for a member. Values are not consistently formatted: most are plain digit-and-dash strings, a few are wrapped in parentheses around the area code.
scope: Contacting or identifying a member by phone number.

name: Major Name
definition: The name of a degree program, for example Business, Finance or International Business. A major name is a full literal value, not a keyword fragment.
scope: Matching a member's field of study to a named program.

name: Department
definition: The academic department, school or program that hosts a major, such as Economics and Finance Department, School of Business or Liberal Arts Program.
scope: Organisational home of a member's major, reached through the major rather than directly from the member.

name: City
definition: The city or place name associated with a zip code in the postal reference table.
scope: Geographic counting and grouping of places within a county and state.

name: County
definition: The county or municipio name associated with a zip code, such as Orange County. Some postal rows carry no county value.
scope: Sub-state geographic grouping; used together with state to scope a set of cities.

name: State
definition: The US state name associated with a zip code, such as Illinois or Virginia. A member's home state is reached through the member's zip code.
scope: State-level geography for members and for postal reference lookups.

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of a club income receipt: Dues, Fundraising, Sponsorship or School Appropration.
scope: Classifying club revenue by how it was obtained.

name: Fundraising Activity
definition: Club activity that raises money beyond membership dues, such as soliciting donations. It is observable only as an income source, not as a kind of event.
scope: Deciding whether an event or an activity counts as a fundraiser.

name: Expense Approval Status
definition: Whether an expense was approved, recorded as the literal string 'true' or left empty when no approval was recorded.
scope: Filtering expenses by approval when a question asks about approved amounts.

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary value of a single expense record.
scope: Base measure for all spending analysis, both per expense and aggregated per member, per budget line or per event.

name: Budget Amount
definition: The total money allocated to a budget line before any spending.
scope: Denominator of budget utilisation and input to the remaining-balance calculation.

name: Budget Spent
definition: The money actually spent against a budget line. It equals the sum of the costs of the expenses charged to that line.
scope: Measuring actual spending against an allocation.

name: Budget Remaining
definition: The money left in a budget line after spending, computed as the allocated amount minus the spent amount. A negative value means the line was overspent.
scope: Checking whether spending stayed within an allocation.

name: Budget Overrun
definition: The magnitude by which a budget line exceeded its allocation, i.e. the amount by which spending surpassed the budget.
scope: Identifying the most over-budget item or event.

name: Event Total Cost
definition: The total amount spent on one event, obtained by summing the costs of the expenses charged to that event's budget lines.
scope: Comparing how expensive events were and finding the cheapest or most expensive event.

name: Attendance Count
definition: The number of members recorded as attending an event, counted from attendance records for that event.
scope: Head-count analysis of event participation and attendance thresholds.

name: Income Amount
definition: The monetary value received in a single income record.
scope: Summing club revenue by source, period or member.

name: Member Full Name
definition: A member's displayed name, formed by combining the stored first name and last name. There is no single stored full-name column.
scope: Identifying or listing members by the name used in natural language.

name: Average Expense Cost
definition: The mean value of expense cost across the expenses under consideration, used as a comparator such as spending more than average.
scope: Threshold comparisons against typical spending.

name: Spend to Budget Ratio
definition: The ratio of the amount spent to the amount allocated for a budget line or for an event's combined budgets, expressing budget utilisation.
scope: Ranking how fully a budget was used, including cases above the allocation.
